subject: Recap + POC plan and data export instructions - NovusData
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@novusdata.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novusdata.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Oct 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next steps for a NovusData POC

Rishi — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap from our side and a request for a concrete POC plan so we can align internal stakeholders.

What we discussed (high-level):
- Goal: validate that Redwood can serve our customer-facing QA assistant with <=200ms auth-user latency and improve answer precision for domain FAQs.
- Scope: 2k monthly active users, mixed short/long queries (avg token length ~38).
- Success signals: automated eval pass rate on curated prompt set + human review for edge cases.

Ask from us: can you send a short POC action plan (timeline, owners, upload instructions for our prompt/log export, and suggested acceptance criteria)? We aim to kick off the trial the week of Oct 9.

Thanks — attaching a small sample of 50 recently anonymized queries for discussion.

[attachment: novus_sample_50.json (application/json)]

—Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Product
NovusData

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@novusdata.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novusdata.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Oct 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps for a NovusData POC

Alex — really helpful recap, thanks and appreciate the sample. High level plan below; I included Marissa (eval lead) and Ben (solutions eng) to own the experimental harness and deployment setup.

1) POC objective (30-day trial): validate quality improvements on NovusData query set and confirm 95th-pctl latency service-level for interactive queries.

2) Success criteria (proposed):
   - Automated metric: >= 78% top-1 exact-match on curated FAQ-style prompts OR >= 85% top-3 relevance judged by our classifier.
   - Human review: among 200 sampled responses, no more than 5% severe incorrects for policy/accuracy-critical queries.
   - SLO: 95th percentile generation latency <= 250ms for typical queries (avg 38 tokens).

3) Data we need from NovusData:
   - Primary: the prompt/log export (JSONL) with anonymized user queries + contextual metadata (timestamp, session-signal if available). Target size: 3,000–5,000 queries for a representative eval set.
   - Optional: a smaller labeled set (100–200) with "expected" answers for quicker automated scoring.

4) Security & transfer:
   - Preferred: upload to our pre-provisioned S3 bucket (s3://redwood-secured-uploads/novusdata/ND-8427/) with temporary creds we’ll provide.
   - Alternative: transfer via secure ShareFile/Box if your security team needs that.
   - We do not need production PII — please follow the redaction checklist in the attached Data Transfer Instructions.

5) Timeline / owners:
   - Oct 4–6: Novus prepares and starts upload (owner: Alex / Priya).
   - Oct 7: Redwood validation of data and pre-processing (owner: Ben Carter).
   - Oct 8–12: Model selection + baseline eval on sample set (owner: Marissa Cole).
   - Oct 13: Joint readout and go/no-go for live traffic (owner: Rishi).

6) Deliverables we’ll provide:
   - Eval harness (automated scoring scripts and dashboard), baseline & tuned model config, and a short readout with recommendations.

Attached: Redwood POC template and transfer instructions. Please confirm the upload plan and whether Oct 9 works for your kickoff.

[attachment: redwood_poc_template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
[attachment: data_transfer_instructions.pdf (application/pdf)]

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@novusdata.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novusdata.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Oct 2028 11:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps for a NovusData POC

Rishi — thanks, this looks great and aligns with what my leadership wants to see. Quick clarifying items from our security and product teams:

- We’ll prepare ~3k anonymized queries for the main eval set. We have an internal redaction tool but want to confirm: is it OK to include session-level flags and non-PII metadata (utm, product_area, bot_flag)?
- For the labelled 150-example set, we’ll include "expected_answer" fields; will your harness accept that JSON field for automated scoring?
- Attached is a 50-query sample export (same as discussed) so your team can validate parsing.

We aim to have the full upload by Oct 6. If anything shows parsing issues, ping Priya and I and we’ll iterate.

[attachment: novus_sample_50.json (application/json)]

Thanks — Alex

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@novusdata.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@novusdata.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Oct 2028 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps for a NovusData POC

Alex / Priya — all good on the questions. Short answers and next steps: 

- Metadata: session-level flags and non-PII metadata are very helpful. Please include them in the JSON; our preprocessor will use them to stratify sampling.
- Labeled examples: yes — include an "expected_answer" (string) field and, optionally, a boolean "is_critical" tag for queries that must be evaluated more conservatively. Our harness will ingest these directly.
- Transfer: we provisioned the S3 path in the MAP; I’m attaching the MAP PDF and the final data-transfer checklist. Once you upload, Ben will validate and open a small parsing report with any anomalies.

Action items assigned:
- Alex / Priya (NovusData): upload anonymized JSONL (3k target) by COB Oct 6 and confirm via Slack (owner: Alex).
- Ben Carter (Redwood): validate parsing and run a quick baseline ingest (due Oct 7).
- Marissa Cole (Redwood): run baseline eval and return the first-readout by Oct 12.
- Rishi: coordinate go/no-go and executive readout on Oct 13.

We’ll keep the acceptance thresholds flexible based on initial baseline; Marissa — can you prepare a short calibration plan (100-sample human review + automated scoring) so we have a fast signal?

[attachment: MAP_Novus_8427.pdf (application/pdf)]

—Rishi

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Alex Johnson <alex.j@novusdata.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Oct 2028 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps for a NovusData POC

Looping in a quick plan from the eval side — thanks for the details above. Short version:

- Calibration: we’ll run a 100-sample human review within 24 hours of ingest to establish a quality baseline. Reviewer rubric attached in the MAP.
- Automated scoring: harness supports "expected_answer" matching (top-1 exact + fuzzy similarity) and classifier-based relevance for top-3.
- Reporting cadence: daily low-fi sync notes (Ben) + one joint readout on Oct 12.

Owners confirmed: Ben (parsing & infra), Marissa (eval scripts + dashboard), Rishi (stakeholder readout).

Please confirm if Oct 9 kickoff still works — otherwise we’ll move the readout to Oct 13 as outlined.

—Marissa Cole
Principal Applied ML Engineer | Redwood Inference
